review_candidates.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key responsibilities Own the architecture, operation and continuous improvement of secure, scalable and highly available AWS infrastructure. Design and maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Enterprise and GitHub Actions. Maintain architecture documentation, runbooks and technical decisions through Jira and Confluence. What we are looking for At least five years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps, Platform Engineering, SRE or a related role. Strong troubleshooting skills.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: What we are looking for At least five years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps, Platform Engineering, SRE or a related role. Strong hands-on experience designing and operating production environments on AWS Solid experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code. Strong communication skills, professional working proficiency in English and the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote environment. Working arrangements and benefits Gross annual base salary of €50,000–€60,000 , depending on experience and technical expertise.
